name: Goggles of Night

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Darkvision 60 ft (or 60 ft more if you already have it).
text: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.
